title: h(t) = 22 − 20cos(πt/5)
caption: The rider oscillates about the centre height 22 m with amplitude 20 m, so h runs from 2 m to 42 m. A turn takes 10 minutes, and starting at the bottom means −cos: h(0) = 22 − 20 = 2.
alt: A wave of height against time for 20 minutes starting at the minimum 2 m at t = 0, rising to 42 m at t = 5 minutes and back to 2 m at t = 10 minutes.
description: The midline is the centre height, 22 m, and the amplitude is the radius, 20 m.
The period is 10 minutes, so B = 2π/10 = π/5.
A cosine starts at its maximum; the rider starts at the minimum, so use −cos.
h(t) = 22 − 20 cos(πt/5): minimum 2 m at t = 0, maximum 42 m at t = 5.
